AND the maintainer direction of 2026-09-13, after attempt 13 aborted at $0 inside `open_run`: the occupancy contract was repaired so that the four artifacts the pre-launch sequence writes into a run may pre-exist, attempt 13 was closed as CONSUMED, and a fresh one-use chain was directed for attempt 14 under the SAME already-approved execution package. No new budget, science or protocol decision was taken.

A FURTHER session needs a new grant, a new launch-bound readiness record, a new authorization and a new bundle -- see execution_package for when that is permitted without a further maintainer decision.
